answer: Agents could earn reputation only through tasks whose outcomes are verified by independent peers, with each verifier staking tokens that are slashed if later audits show collusion or false reports. A new identity starts with no stake or history, so splitting into many accounts does not multiply influence; the attacker must fund each account and risk losing deposits while coordinating convincing work. Even a nectar delivery tagged violet or walnut can build standing only when distinct, accountable agents confirm it.
